id-20261022-news-1.title: Ahead of COP31 November 2026: What Is at Stake for Indonesia in Carbon Markets, Climate Finance, and Emission Targets

segments.src: Konferensi Perubahan Iklim PBB ke-31 (COP31) dijadwalkan berlangsung pada November 2026 di Antalya, Turki, dengan Australia memimpin proses negosiasi.
segments.tr: The 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) is scheduled for November 2026 in Antalya, Turkey, with Australia leading the negotiation process.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, pertemuan ini bukan sekadar agenda diplomasi.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, this meeting is not merely a diplomatic agenda.

segments.src: Hasilnya bisa memengaruhi arah bursa karbon, aliran dana transisi energi, dan beban penyesuaian bagi industri maupun rumah tangga.
segments.tr: Its outcomes could affect the direction of the carbon exchange, the flow of energy transition funding, and the adjustment burden on industry and households.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum tiga isu utama yang kemungkinan menjadi perhatian Indonesia, beserta dampak yang perlu dicermati.
segments.tr: This article summarizes three main issues that are likely to matter to Indonesia, along with the impacts that need watching.

segments.src: Angka dan jadwal dapat berubah, jadi pembaca disarankan merujuk pada dokumen resmi pemerintah dan sekretariat UNFCCC.
segments.tr: Figures and schedules may change, so readers are advised to refer to official government documents and the UNFCCC secretariat.

segments.src: ## Mengapa COP31 penting bagi Indonesia
segments.tr: ## Why COP31 matters for Indonesia

segments.src: Indonesia adalah salah satu negara dengan emisi gas rumah kaca terbesar di dunia.
segments.tr: Indonesia is one of the countries with the largest greenhouse gas emissions in the world.

segments.src: Emisi itu berasal dari sektor energi, kehutanan dan alih guna lahan, serta industri.
segments.tr: These emissions come from the energy sector, forestry and land-use change, and industry.

segments.src: Pada saat yang sama, Indonesia memiliki hutan tropis dan lahan gambut luas yang berperan besar sebagai penyerap karbon, serta cadangan nikel yang penting bagi rantai pasok baterai kendaraan listrik.
segments.tr: At the same time, Indonesia has extensive tropical forests and peatlands that play a major role as carbon sinks, as well as nickel reserves that are important to the electric vehicle battery supply chain.

segments.src: Posisi ganda ini membuat Indonesia berkepentingan pada aturan global yang adil.
segments.tr: This dual position means Indonesia has a stake in fair global rules.

segments.src: Negara ini ingin menekan emisi, tetapi juga perlu menjaga pertumbuhan ekonomi dan lapangan kerja.
segments.tr: The country wants to cut emissions, but it also needs to sustain economic growth and employment.

segments.src: ## 1. Pasar karbon dan bursa karbon
segments.tr: ## 1. Carbon markets and the carbon exchange

segments.src: Indonesia meluncurkan Bursa Karbon Indonesia (IDXCarbon) pada September 2023 di bawah pengawasan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK).
segments.tr: Indonesia launched the Indonesia Carbon Exchange (IDXCarbon) in September 2023 under the supervision of the Financial Services Authority (OJK).

segments.src: Perdagangan awalnya difokuskan pada unit karbon dari pembangkit listrik batu bara, lalu diperluas ke perdagangan karbon luar negeri dan sektor lain.
segments.tr: Trading initially focused on carbon units from coal-fired power plants, then expanded to international carbon trading and other sectors.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang layak diperhatikan menjelang COP31:
segments.tr: Several matters deserve attention ahead of COP31:

segments.src: - **Aturan Pasal 6 Perjanjian Paris.** Pasal ini mengatur perdagangan karbon antarnegara. Kejelasan standar akan menentukan apakah kredit karbon Indonesia diakui pembeli luar negeri.
segments.tr: - **Article 6 of the Paris Agreement.** This article governs carbon trading between countries. Clear standards will determine whether Indonesian carbon credits are recognized by foreign buyers.

segments.src: - **Integritas kredit karbon.** Pembeli global semakin menuntut bukti bahwa pengurangan emisi benar-benar terjadi, tidak dihitung ganda, dan bersifat permanen.
segments.tr: - **Carbon credit integrity.** Global buyers increasingly demand proof that emission reductions truly occur, are not double-counted, and are permanent.

segments.src: - **Likuiditas bursa.** Volume transaksi di bursa karbon domestik masih relatif kecil dibanding potensinya. Kepastian regulasi dan harga menjadi kunci untuk menarik lebih banyak peserta.
segments.tr: - **Exchange liquidity.** Transaction volume on the domestic carbon exchange is still relatively small compared with its potential. Regulatory and price certainty are key to attracting more participants.

segments.src: - **Mekanisme penyesuaian karbon perbatasan.** Kebijakan seperti CBAM Uni Eropa dapat memengaruhi ekspor produk padat karbon, misalnya baja dan aluminium. Eksportir Indonesia perlu menyiapkan data emisi yang andal.
segments.tr: - **Carbon border adjustment mechanisms.** Policies such as the EU's CBAM could affect exports of carbon-intensive products, such as steel and aluminum. Indonesian exporters need to prepare reliable emissions data.

segments.src: ## 2. Pendanaan transisi energi
segments.tr: ## 2. Energy transition financing

segments.src: Transisi dari energi fosil ke energi bersih membutuhkan investasi besar.
segments.tr: The shift from fossil fuels to clean energy requires large investment.

segments.src: Salah satu kerangka yang paling sering dibahas adalah Kemitraan Transisi Energi yang Adil (JETP), yang diumumkan pada 2022 dengan komitmen awal sekitar 20 miliar dolar AS dari negara-negara mitra dan lembaga keuangan.
segments.tr: One of the frameworks most often discussed is the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP), announced in 2022 with an initial commitment of around US$20 billion from partner countries and financial institutions.

segments.src: Perkembangan kemitraan ini, termasuk perubahan sikap sejumlah mitra, menjadi catatan penting dalam diskusi pendanaan.
segments.tr: The partnership's development, including shifts in the stance of some partners, is an important point in the financing discussion.

segments.src: Isu yang kemungkinan mengemuka:
segments.tr: Issues likely to come up:

segments.src: - **Komposisi dana.** Proporsi hibah, pinjaman lunak, dan pinjaman komersial sangat memengaruhi beban utang negara.
segments.tr: - **Composition of funds.** The proportions of grants, concessional loans, and commercial loans strongly affect the state's debt burden.

segments.src: - **Percepatan penghentian pembangkit batu bara.** Pemerintah telah menyampaikan rencana mengurangi peran batu bara, tetapi laju dan sumber pembiayaannya masih perlu kejelasan.
segments.tr: - **Accelerating the phase-out of coal plants.** The government has conveyed plans to reduce coal's role, but the pace and source of financing still need clarity.

segments.src: - **Energi terbarukan.** Tenaga surya, panas bumi, dan tenaga air memiliki potensi besar. Hambatannya mencakup jaringan transmisi, perizinan, dan kepastian tarif.
segments.tr: - **Renewable energy.** Solar, geothermal, and hydropower have large potential. Obstacles include transmission networks, licensing, and tariff certainty.

segments.src: - **Target pendanaan iklim global.** Negara berkembang mendorong kenaikan dana iklim dari negara maju. Hasil perundingan akan menentukan seberapa besar ruang pembiayaan yang tersedia bagi Indonesia.
segments.tr: - **Global climate finance target.** Developing countries are pushing for higher climate finance from developed countries. The outcome of the negotiations will determine how much financing room is available to Indonesia.

segments.src: ## 3. Target pengurangan emisi
segments.tr: ## 3. Emission reduction targets

segments.src: Dalam Dokumen Kontribusi yang Ditetapkan secara Nasional (NDC), Indonesia menargetkan penurunan emisi sebesar 31,89 persen dengan upaya sendiri dan hingga 43,20 persen dengan dukungan internasional pada 2030, dibandingkan skenario tanpa tindakan.
segments.tr: In its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), Indonesia targets a 31.89 percent emission reduction with its own efforts and up to 43.20 percent with international support by 2030, compared with a business-as-usual scenario.

segments.src: Pemerintah juga menyebut target emisi nol bersih pada 2060 atau lebih cepat.
segments.tr: The government also cites a net-zero emissions target by 2060 or earlier.

segments.src: Pembaruan NDC dengan target tahun 2035 menjadi bahan evaluasi di COP31.
segments.tr: The NDC update with a 2035 target is a subject of evaluation at COP31.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang sering diajukan pengamat antara lain:
segments.tr: Questions frequently raised by observers include:

segments.src: - Apakah target tersebut selaras dengan batas kenaikan suhu 1,5 derajat Celsius?
segments.tr: - Is the target aligned with the 1.5 degrees Celsius temperature limit?

segments.src: - Seberapa jelas rencana pelaksanaan di sektor energi, kehutanan, dan industri?
segments.tr: - How clear is the implementation plan in the energy, forestry, and industry sectors?

segments.src: - Bagaimana sistem pemantauan dan pelaporan emisi dijalankan secara transparan?
segments.tr: - How is the emissions monitoring and reporting system run transparently?

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi industri dan warga
segments.tr: ## Impact on industry and citizens

segments.src: **Bagi industri:**
segments.tr: **For industry:**

segments.src: - Perusahaan besar kemungkinan menghadapi kewajiban pelaporan emisi yang lebih ketat.
segments.tr: - Large companies will likely face stricter emissions reporting obligations.

segments.src: - Biaya karbon dapat memengaruhi sektor pembangkit listrik, semen, baja, dan pertambangan.
segments.tr: - Carbon costs may affect the power generation, cement, steel, and mining sectors.

segments.src: - Peluang baru muncul di energi terbarukan, efisiensi energi, dan proyek penyerapan karbon.
segments.tr: - New opportunities are emerging in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and carbon sink projects.

segments.src: **Bagi warga:**
segments.tr: **For citizens:**

segments.src: - Tarif listrik dapat terpengaruh oleh perubahan bauran energi dan kebijakan subsidi.
segments.tr: - Electricity tariffs may be affected by changes in the energy mix and subsidy policies.

segments.src: - Pekerja di sektor batu bara membutuhkan program pelatihan ulang dan perlindungan sosial agar transisi berjalan adil.
segments.tr: - Coal sector workers need retraining programs and social protection so the transition is fair.

segments.src: - Kendaraan listrik, transportasi publik, dan panel surya atap makin banyak menjadi pilihan, meski akses dan harganya belum merata.
segments.tr: - Electric vehicles, public transport, and rooftop solar panels are increasingly popular choices, although access and prices are not yet evenly distributed.

segments.src: - Komunitas adat dan masyarakat sekitar hutan perlu dilibatkan dalam proyek karbon agar manfaatnya sampai ke tingkat tapak.
segments.tr: - Indigenous communities and people living around forests need to be involved in carbon projects so the benefits reach the local level.

segments.src: ## Hal yang perlu dicermati
segments.tr: ## Points to watch

segments.src: 1. Hasil perundingan Pasal 6 dan standar pasar karbon.
segments.tr: 1. Outcomes of the Article 6 negotiations and carbon market standards.

segments.src: 2. Komitmen pendanaan baru dari negara maju dan bank pembangunan.
segments.tr: 2. New financing commitments from developed countries and development banks.

segments.src: 3. Penjelasan resmi pemerintah soal NDC terbaru dan peta jalan transisi energi.
segments.tr: 3. Official government explanations of the latest NDC and the energy transition roadmap.

segments.src: 4. Kebijakan turunan di dalam negeri, mulai dari regulasi OJK hingga tarif listrik.
segments.tr: 4. Domestic follow-up policies, from OJK regulations to electricity tariffs.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: COP31 akan menguji sejauh mana janji global diterjemahkan menjadi tindakan nyata.
segments.tr: COP31 will test how far global promises are turned into concrete action.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, tantangannya adalah menyeimbangkan ambisi iklim, kebutuhan pendanaan, dan kepentingan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, the challenge is to balance climate ambition, financing needs, and national economic interests.

segments.src: Warga dapat mengikuti perkembangannya melalui sumber resmi dan pemberitaan yang kredibel.
segments.tr: Citizens can follow developments through official sources and credible news reporting.

id-20261022-news-2.title: Harbolnas 11.11 and Year-End Online Shopping: How to Spot Fake Discounts, Protect Consumer Rights, and Avoid Fraud

segments.src: Setiap menjelang akhir tahun, kalender belanja daring di Indonesia mendadak padat.
segments.tr: Every year-end, the online shopping calendar in Indonesia suddenly gets crowded.

segments.src: Setelah 11.11 datang 12.12, lalu Hari Belanja Online Nasional (Harbolnas) dan promo penutup tahun.
segments.tr: After 11.11 comes 12.12, then National Online Shopping Day (Harbolnas) and the year-end promotions.

segments.src: Platform e-commerce biasanya menyiapkan potongan harga, gratis ongkos kirim, dan voucher dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: E-commerce platforms usually prepare large price cuts, free shipping, and vouchers.

segments.src: Bagi konsumen, ini peluang menghemat.
segments.tr: For consumers, this is an opportunity to save.

segments.src: Namun keramaian yang sama juga dimanfaatkan pihak yang tidak bertanggung jawab.
segments.tr: However, the same crowds are also exploited by irresponsible parties.

segments.src: Artikel ini membahas cara mengenali diskon yang menyesatkan, hak konsumen yang perlu diketahui, mekanisme pengembalian barang, dan modus penipuan yang kerap muncul di musim promo.
segments.tr: This article discusses how to recognize misleading discounts, the consumer rights you should know, return mechanisms, and fraud schemes that often appear during promotion season.

segments.src: ## Mengapa musim diskon rawan masalah?
segments.tr: ## Why are shopping seasons prone to problems?

segments.src: Ada beberapa alasan mengapa periode 11.11 dan 12.12 lebih rawan dibanding hari biasa:
segments.tr: There are several reasons why the 11.11 and 12.12 periods are more risky than ordinary days:

segments.src: - **Volume transaksi melonjak.** Penjual, kurir, dan layanan pelanggan bekerja pada kapasitas tinggi, sehingga kesalahan pengiriman dan keterlambatan lebih mungkin terjadi.
segments.tr: - **Transaction volume surges.** Sellers, couriers, and customer service operate at high capacity, so shipping errors and delays are more likely.

segments.src: - **Tekanan waktu.** Penghitung mundur dan label "stok hampir habis" mendorong orang memutuskan cepat tanpa membaca rincian.
segments.tr: - **Time pressure.** Countdown timers and "almost sold out" labels push people to decide quickly without reading the details.

segments.src: - **Banyak pesan promosi.** Pesan dan tautan bertema diskon beredar luas, sehingga pesan palsu mudah menyusup di antaranya.
segments.tr: - **Many promotional messages.** Discount-themed messages and links circulate widely, so fake messages can easily slip in among them.

segments.src: Memahami pola ini membantu Anda tetap tenang dan berbelanja dengan lebih terukur.
segments.tr: Understanding these patterns helps you stay calm and shop more deliberately.

segments.src: ## Cara mengenali diskon yang menyesatkan
segments.tr: ## How to recognize misleading discounts

segments.src: Tidak semua potongan harga yang tampak besar benar-benar menguntungkan.
segments.tr: Not every large price cut is truly a good deal.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang layak diperiksa:
segments.tr: A few things are worth checking:

segments.src: 1. **Bandingkan dengan harga sebelumnya.** Sebelum musim promo, catat atau tangkap layar harga barang yang Anda incar. Jika harga "coret" jauh lebih tinggi daripada harga yang pernah Anda lihat, patut dicurigai bahwa angka awalnya digelembungkan.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare with the previous price.** Before promotion season, note or screenshot the price of the item you want. If the "crossed-out" price is much higher than prices you have seen before, suspect that the original price was inflated.

segments.src: 2. **Cek harga di beberapa toko.** Barang yang sama sering dijual dengan harga mirip di toko lain. Selisih yang terlalu jauh dari harga pasar perlu dipertanyakan.
segments.tr: 2. **Check prices at several stores.** The same item is often sold at similar prices elsewhere. A difference that is too large from the market price should be questioned.

segments.src: 3. **Baca syarat dan ketentuan voucher.** Potongan "hingga 90%" biasanya hanya berlaku untuk produk tertentu, jumlah terbatas, atau dengan minimum belanja. Perhatikan batas maksimum potongan dan masa berlaku.
segments.tr: 3. **Read the voucher terms and conditions.** "Up to 90% off" usually applies only to certain products, limited quantities, or with a minimum spend. Pay attention to the maximum discount cap and the validity period.

segments.src: 4. **Hitung total akhir.** Ongkos kirim, biaya layanan, dan biaya lain bisa mengurangi hemat yang dijanjikan. Bandingkan total akhir, bukan hanya harga etalase.
segments.tr: 4. **Calculate the final total.** Shipping costs, service fees, and other charges can reduce the promised savings. Compare the final total, not just the listed price.

segments.src: 5. **Periksa spesifikasi dan ulasan.** Pastikan varian, ukuran, dan kondisi barang (baru atau bekas) sesuai deskripsi. Baca ulasan dengan foto, dan waspadai ulasan yang seragam dan berlebihan.
segments.tr: 5. **Check specifications and reviews.** Make sure the variant, size, and condition of the item (new or used) match the description. Read reviews that include photos, and be wary of reviews that are uniform and excessive.

segments.src: 6. **Waspadai tekanan psikologis.** Penghitung mundur tidak selalu berarti kesempatan terakhir. Beri diri Anda waktu singkat untuk menimbang apakah barang itu memang dibutuhkan.
segments.tr: 6. **Beware of psychological pressure.** A countdown does not always mean it is your last chance. Give yourself a short moment to consider whether you really need the item.

segments.src: ## Hak konsumen yang perlu diketahui
segments.tr: ## Consumer rights you should know

segments.src: Di Indonesia, perlindungan konsumen diatur antara lain dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 8 Tahun 1999 tentang Perlindungan Konsumen, serta aturan turunan mengenai perdagangan melalui sistem elektronik.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, consumer protection is regulated, among others, by Law Number 8 of 1999 on Consumer Protection, as well as its implementing regulations on trade through electronic systems.

segments.src: Secara umum, konsumen berhak atas:
segments.tr: In general, consumers are entitled to:

segments.src: - **Informasi yang benar, jelas, dan jujur** mengenai kondisi, harga, dan jaminan barang atau jasa.
segments.tr: - **Correct, clear, and honest information** about the condition, price, and warranty of goods or services.

segments.src: - **Kenyamanan, keamanan, dan keselamatan** dalam menggunakan barang yang dibeli.
segments.tr: - **Comfort, security, and safety** when using the goods purchased.

segments.src: - **Barang sesuai dengan nilai tukar dan keterangan** yang dijanjikan.
segments.tr: - **Goods that match the agreed value and the stated description.**

segments.src: - **Didengar pendapat dan keluhannya**, serta mendapat advokasi dan penyelesaian sengketa secara patut.
segments.tr: - **Having their opinions and complaints heard**, and receiving advocacy and fair dispute resolution.

segments.src: - **Kompensasi, ganti rugi, atau penggantian** apabila barang tidak sesuai perjanjian atau tidak sebagaimana mestinya.
segments.tr: - **Compensation, damages, or replacement** if goods do not conform to the agreement or are not as they should be.

segments.src: Sebagai pembeli, Anda juga punya tanggung jawab: membaca informasi dengan teliti, beritikad baik, dan mengikuti prosedur pembayaran serta pengajuan keluhan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: As a buyer, you also have responsibilities: reading information carefully, acting in good faith, and following the applicable payment and complaint procedures.

segments.src: ## Mekanisme pengembalian barang dan pengajuan komplain
segments.tr: ## Return mechanisms and filing complaints

segments.src: Setiap platform memiliki kebijakan yang berbeda, sehingga cara terbaik adalah membaca ketentuan pengembalian sebelum membeli.
segments.tr: Each platform has different policies, so the best approach is to read the return terms before buying.

segments.src: Langkah-langkah umum yang biasa berlaku:
segments.tr: Common general steps that usually apply:

segments.src: 1. **Periksa paket saat diterima.** Jika memungkinkan, rekam video saat membuka paket (unboxing) tanpa terputus. Rekaman ini sering menjadi bukti penting bila barang rusak atau tidak lengkap.
segments.tr: 1. **Check the package when you receive it.** If possible, record a continuous video while opening the package (unboxing). This recording is often important evidence if the item is damaged or incomplete.

segments.src: 2. **Perhatikan batas waktu.** Banyak platform membatasi waktu pengajuan komplain setelah barang diterima atau setelah pesanan ditandai selesai. Jangan menunda.
segments.tr: 2. **Watch the deadlines.** Many platforms limit the time for filing a complaint after receiving the item or after the order is marked complete. Don't delay.

segments.src: 3. **Ajukan lewat fitur resmi di aplikasi.** Gunakan menu pengajuan pengembalian atau komplain pada platform, bukan kesepakatan di luar aplikasi.
segments.tr: 3. **File through the official in-app feature.** Use the platform's return or complaint menu, not agreements made outside the app.

segments.src: 4. **Lampirkan bukti.** Foto, video, dan tangkapan layar percakapan mendukung klaim Anda.
segments.tr: 4. **Attach evidence.** Photos, videos, and screenshots of conversations support your claim.

segments.src: 5. **Simpan bukti transaksi.** Bukti pembayaran, nomor pesanan, dan nomor resi berguna jika diperlukan eskalasi.
segments.tr: 5. **Keep transaction records.** Payment proof, order numbers, and shipping receipt numbers are useful if escalation is needed.

segments.src: 6. **Gunakan jalur lanjutan jika perlu.** Jika keluhan tidak terselesaikan, Anda dapat mengajukan pengaduan ke layanan pelanggan platform, lalu ke lembaga perlindungan konsumen seperti Direktorat Jenderal Perlindungan Konsumen dan Tertib Niaga Kementerian Perdagangan, Badan Penyelesaian Sengketa Konsumen (BPSK), atau Yayasan Lembaga Konsumen Indonesia (YLKI).
segments.tr: 6. **Use further channels if needed.** If the complaint is not resolved, you can file a report with the platform's customer service, then with consumer protection bodies such as the Directorate General of Consumer Protection and Trade Compliance at the Ministry of Trade, the Consumer Dispute Resolution Agency (BPSK), or the Indonesian Consumer Foundation (YLKI).

segments.src: Catatan: ketentuan rinci seperti barang yang dapat dikembalikan, siapa yang menanggung ongkos kirim retur, dan lama proses pengembalian dana berbeda pada setiap platform dan kategori produk.
segments.tr: Note: detailed rules such as which goods can be returned, who bears the return shipping cost, and how long refunds take differ by platform and product category.

segments.src: Selalu rujuk kebijakan resmi yang berlaku pada saat Anda berbelanja.
segments.tr: Always refer to the official policy in effect at the time you shop.

segments.src: ## Modus penipuan yang kerap muncul di musim diskon
segments.tr: ## Fraud schemes that often appear during discount season

segments.src: Berikut pola yang sering dilaporkan, disertai cara menyikapinya:
segments.tr: The following patterns are frequently reported, along with how to respond:

segments.src: - **Tautan dan pesan palsu bertema promo.** Pesan lewat SMS, aplikasi percakapan, atau surel yang mengaku dari marketplace dan menawarkan voucher atau hadiah. Jangan klik tautan sembarangan. Buka aplikasi resmi secara langsung untuk memeriksa promo.
segments.tr: - **Fake links and messages themed around promotions.** Messages via SMS, chat apps, or email that claim to be from a marketplace and offer vouchers or prizes. Don't click links carelessly. Open the official app directly to check promotions.

segments.src: - **Situs tiruan.** Alamat situs dibuat mirip dengan situs asli. Periksa ejaan alamat dengan teliti dan hindari memasukkan data di halaman yang Anda buka dari tautan tidak dikenal.
segments.tr: - **Lookalike websites.** Website addresses made to look similar to the genuine site. Check the spelling of the address carefully and avoid entering data on pages you opened from unknown links.

segments.src: - **Permintaan kode OTP atau PIN.** Pihak yang sah tidak akan meminta kode OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi Anda. Jangan bagikan kode tersebut kepada siapa pun, termasuk yang mengaku petugas layanan pelanggan.
segments.tr: - **Requests for OTP codes or PINs.** Legitimate parties will never ask for your OTP, PIN, or password. Do not share these codes with anyone, including people claiming to be customer service staff.

segments.src: - **Ajakan transaksi di luar aplikasi.** Penjual yang mengajak pindah ke percakapan pribadi dan meminta transfer langsung ke rekening pribadi menghilangkan perlindungan yang disediakan sistem pembayaran platform.
segments.tr: - **Invitations to transact outside the app.** Sellers who move the conversation to private chat and request direct transfers to a personal account remove the protection provided by the platform's payment system.

segments.src: - **Harga terlalu murah untuk masuk akal.** Barang bermerek dengan harga jauh di bawah pasar bisa berarti barang palsu, barang tidak ada, atau jebakan pembayaran.
segments.tr: - **Prices too cheap to be reasonable.** Branded goods priced far below market can mean counterfeit goods, nonexistent goods, or a payment trap.

segments.src: - **Kurir atau paket palsu.** Pesan yang menyebut ada paket bermasalah dan meminta Anda membuka berkas atau tautan tertentu. Cocokkan nomor resi lewat situs atau aplikasi resmi kurir.
segments.tr: - **Fake couriers or packages.** Messages saying there is a problem with a package and asking you to open a particular file or link. Match the tracking number through the courier's official website or app.

segments.src: - **Salah transfer berkedok pengembalian dana.** Pihak yang mengaku salah mengirim dana lalu meminta Anda mengembalikannya ke rekening lain. Hubungi bank Anda melalui kanal resmi sebelum melakukan apa pun.
segments.tr: - **Mistaken transfer scams disguised as refunds.** Someone claims to have sent money by mistake and asks you to return it to another account. Contact your bank through official channels before doing anything.

segments.src: - **Aplikasi tidak resmi.** Pasang aplikasi hanya dari toko aplikasi resmi, dan jangan menginstal berkas yang dikirim lewat pesan.
segments.tr: - **Unofficial apps.** Install apps only from official app stores, and do not install files sent via messages.

segments.src: ## Kebiasaan aman saat berbelanja
segments.tr: ## Safe shopping habits

segments.src: - Aktifkan verifikasi dua langkah pada akun marketplace, surel, dan layanan dompet digital.
segments.tr: - Enable two-factor verification on marketplace accounts, email, and digital wallet services.

segments.src: - Gunakan kata sandi yang berbeda untuk tiap layanan.
segments.tr: - Use a different password for each service.

segments.src: - Pilih metode pembayaran yang tercatat di sistem platform, dan pertimbangkan batas transaksi pada kartu atau dompet digital.
segments.tr: - Choose payment methods recorded in the platform's system, and consider transaction limits on cards or digital wallets.

segments.src: - Periksa reputasi toko: lama beroperasi, penilaian, dan respons terhadap komplain.
segments.tr: - Check the store's reputation: how long it has operated, its ratings, and how it responds to complaints.

segments.src: - Atur anggaran sebelum mulai. Buat daftar kebutuhan agar tidak tergoda membeli barang yang tidak direncanakan.
segments.tr: - Set a budget before you start. Make a list of needs so you are not tempted to buy unplanned items.

segments.src: - Pantau mutasi rekening dan notifikasi transaksi secara berkala setelah periode belanja.
segments.tr: - Monitor your account statements and transaction notifications regularly after the shopping period.

segments.src: ## Jika sudah terlanjur menjadi korban
segments.tr: ## If you have already fallen victim

segments.src: 1. **Hubungi bank atau penyedia dompet digital** sesegera mungkin melalui kanal resmi untuk menanyakan kemungkinan pemblokiran atau penanganan transaksi.
segments.tr: 1. **Contact your bank or digital wallet provider** as soon as possible through official channels to ask about possible blocking or handling of the transaction.

segments.src: 2. **Ubah kata sandi** akun yang mungkin terdampak, dan keluarkan perangkat asing dari daftar sesi login.
segments.tr: 2. **Change the password** of any accounts that may be affected, and remove unfamiliar devices from the list of login sessions.

segments.src: 3. **Laporkan ke platform** tempat kejadian berlangsung beserta bukti yang Anda miliki.
segments.tr: 3. **Report to the platform** where the incident took place, along with the evidence you have.

segments.src: 4. **Laporkan ke pihak berwenang.** Anda dapat memanfaatkan kanal pengaduan resmi pemerintah dan kepolisian untuk kejahatan siber. Siapkan bukti transfer, tangkapan layar percakapan, dan identitas rekening tujuan.
segments.tr: 4. **Report to the authorities.** You can use the government's official complaint channels and the police for cybercrime. Prepare proof of transfer, screenshots of conversations, and the identity of the destination account.

segments.src: 5. **Beri tahu orang terdekat** agar mereka waspada terhadap modus serupa.
segments.tr: 5. **Inform people close to you** so they can be alert to similar schemes.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Festival belanja seperti 11.11 dan 12.12 dapat menjadi kesempatan berhemat bila dijalani dengan persiapan.
segments.tr: Shopping festivals such as 11.11 and 12.12 can be an opportunity to save when approached with preparation.

segments.src: Kuncinya sederhana: bandingkan harga, baca ketentuan, simpan bukti, bertransaksi lewat jalur resmi, dan jangan pernah membagikan kode rahasia.
segments.tr: The key is simple: compare prices, read the terms, keep records, transact through official channels, and never share secret codes.

segments.src: Mengetahui hak sebagai konsumen membuat Anda lebih percaya diri bila terjadi masalah, sementara kewaspadaan terhadap modus penipuan melindungi uang dan data pribadi Anda.
segments.tr: Knowing your rights as a consumer makes you more confident if problems arise, while vigilance against fraud protects your money and personal data.

segments.src: *Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat hukum atau keuangan.
segments.tr: *This article is general information and not legal or financial advice.

segments.src: Kebijakan setiap platform dan peraturan dapat berubah, sehingga periksa informasi resmi terbaru sebelum bertransaksi.*
segments.tr: Each platform's policies and regulations may change, so check the latest official information before transacting.*

id-20261022-news-3.title: Christmas and New Year 2026/2027 Holiday: Airfare Price Patterns, Travel Flows, and How to Plan a Budget Trip

segments.src: Masa Natal dan Tahun Baru (Nataru) 2026/2027 sudah di depan mata.
segments.tr: Christmas and New Year (Nataru) 2026/2027 is just around the corner.

segments.src: Setiap tahun, periode ini menjadi salah satu puncak pergerakan orang di Indonesia.
segments.tr: Every year, this period becomes one of the peak times of travel across Indonesia.

segments.src: Tahun ini, 25 Desember 2026 dan 1 Januari 2027 sama-sama jatuh pada hari Jumat, sehingga akhir pekan panjang berpeluang mendorong lebih banyak orang bepergian.
segments.tr: This year, 25 December 2026 and 1 January 2027 both fall on a Friday, so the long weekends may encourage more people to travel.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum pola yang biasa terjadi pada harga tiket, arus mobilitas, dan kesiapan angkutan, lalu memberi langkah praktis untuk merencanakan perjalanan lebih awal dan hemat.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the patterns that typically occur with ticket prices, travel flows, and transport readiness, then offers practical steps for planning your trip early and saving money.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum berdasarkan pola tahun-tahun sebelumnya. Harga, jadwal, dan kebijakan dapat berubah. Selalu cek informasi terbaru di kanal resmi maskapai, PT KAI, operator tol, dan pemerintah sebelum memutuskan.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is general information based on patterns from previous years. Prices, schedules, and policies may change. Always check the latest information on the official channels of airlines, PT KAI, toll road operators, and the government before making a decision.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Permintaan Transportasi Naik Saat Nataru
segments.tr: ## Why Transport Demand Rises During Nataru

segments.src: Libur akhir tahun mempertemukan beberapa kebutuhan sekaligus: ibadah Natal, berkumpul bersama keluarga, liburan sekolah, dan pergantian tahun.
segments.tr: The year-end holiday brings together several needs at once: Christmas worship, gathering with family, school holidays, and the New Year.

segments.src: Akibatnya, permintaan melonjak pada waktu yang hampir bersamaan.
segments.tr: As a result, demand surges at nearly the same times.

segments.src: Pada tahun-tahun sebelumnya, lonjakan biasanya terlihat pada:
segments.tr: In previous years, the surges typically appeared:

segments.src: - **Beberapa hari sebelum 24–25 Desember**, ketika orang pulang kampung atau berangkat berlibur.
segments.tr: - **A few days before 24–25 December**, when people head home or leave on vacation.

segments.src: - **Sekitar 29 Desember hingga 1 Januari**, saat banyak orang menuju destinasi wisata untuk merayakan tahun baru.
segments.tr: - **Around 29 December to 1 January**, when many people travel to tourist destinations to celebrate the New Year.

segments.src: - **Awal Januari**, ketika arus balik terjadi dan jalur utama kembali padat.
segments.tr: - **Early January**, when the return trips happen and main routes become crowded again.

segments.src: Pola ini membuat hari keberangkatan dan jam perjalanan sangat menentukan, baik dari sisi harga maupun kenyamanan.
segments.tr: This pattern makes the departure date and travel time very important, both for price and for comfort.

segments.src: ## Pola Harga Tiket Pesawat
segments.tr: ## Airfare Price Patterns

segments.src: Harga tiket pesawat umumnya bergerak mengikuti keseimbangan antara jumlah kursi dan permintaan.
segments.tr: Airfares generally move with the balance between available seats and demand.

segments.src: Beberapa pola yang lazim terjadi:
segments.tr: Some common patterns:

segments.src: 1. **Harga naik seiring mendekati hari keberangkatan.** Kelas tarif murah biasanya habis lebih dahulu, sehingga pembeli yang menunda akan mendapat kelas tarif yang lebih mahal.
segments.tr: 1. **Prices rise as the departure date approaches.** Lower fare classes usually sell out first, so buyers who wait will end up with more expensive fare classes.

segments.src: 2. **Hari puncak lebih mahal.** Tanggal-tanggal di sekitar 23–24 Desember dan 30–31 Desember cenderung menjadi yang tertinggi pada rute populer, seperti Jakarta–Surabaya, Jakarta–Bali, dan Jakarta–Medan.
segments.tr: 2. **Peak days are more expensive.** Dates around 23–24 December and 30–31 December tend to be the highest on popular routes, such as Jakarta–Surabaya, Jakarta–Bali, and Jakarta–Medan.

segments.src: 3. **Hari non-puncak lebih bersahabat.** Berangkat beberapa hari lebih awal atau pada hari kerja biasanya memberi pilihan harga yang lebih longgar.
segments.tr: 3. **Non-peak days are friendlier.** Departing a few days earlier or on a weekday usually offers more affordable price options.

segments.src: 4. **Ada batas atas tarif.** Tarif batas atas pesawat kelas ekonomi ditetapkan pemerintah, dan pemerintah dapat memberi kebijakan khusus pada periode libur. Cek pengumuman resmi Kementerian Perhubungan untuk kebijakan terbaru.
segments.tr: 4. **There is a fare ceiling.** The government sets the upper fare limit for economy-class flights, and the government may introduce special policies during holiday periods. Check the latest official announcements from the Ministry of Transportation for current policies.

segments.src: **Tips:** Gunakan fitur pemantau harga atau kalender harga di aplikasi pemesanan, bandingkan beberapa maskapai, dan perhatikan biaya bagasi.
segments.tr: **Tips:** Use the price tracker or price calendar feature in the booking app, compare several airlines, and watch out for baggage fees.

segments.src: Tiket murah dengan bagasi tambahan bisa berakhir lebih mahal daripada tiket yang sudah termasuk bagasi.
segments.tr: A cheap ticket with extra baggage fees can end up costing more than a ticket that already includes baggage.

segments.src: ## Kereta Api: Pilihan Andalan dengan Kuota Terbatas
segments.tr: ## Trains: A Reliable Choice With Limited Quota

segments.src: Kereta api tetap menjadi moda favorit karena jadwalnya relatif tepat waktu dan tarifnya jelas.
segments.tr: Trains remain a favorite mode of travel because their schedules are relatively punctual and their fares are clear.

segments.src: Namun kuota kursi terbatas, sehingga tiket pada tanggal favorit sering terjual habis jauh hari.
segments.tr: However, seat quotas are limited, so tickets for popular dates often sell out well in advance.

segments.src: - Pemesanan umumnya dibuka beberapa waktu sebelum keberangkatan melalui aplikasi resmi dan kanal penjualan resmi PT KAI. Periksa ketentuan jadwal pembukaan penjualan terbaru.
segments.tr: - Booking usually opens some time before departure through PT KAI's official app and official sales channels. Check the latest booking schedule terms.

segments.src: - Tarif kereta jarak jauh bisa berbeda menurut kelas dan subkelas. Subkelas dengan harga lebih rendah biasanya terisi lebih dahulu.
segments.tr: - Long-distance train fares can differ by class and subclass. Lower-priced subclasses usually fill up first.

segments.src: - Hindari membeli tiket dari pihak yang tidak resmi. Pastikan nama penumpang sesuai identitas karena pengecekan dilakukan saat naik.
segments.tr: - Avoid buying tickets from unofficial parties. Make sure the passenger name matches the identity document, because checks are carried out when boarding.

segments.src: - PT KAI sering menambah perjalanan tambahan pada masa libur. Pantau pengumuman resmi jika jadwal pilihan Anda sudah penuh.
segments.tr: - PT KAI often adds extra trips during holiday periods. Monitor official announcements if your preferred schedule is already full.

segments.src: ## Jalan Tol dan Perjalanan Darat
segments.tr: ## Toll Roads and Land Travel

segments.src: Bagi pengguna kendaraan pribadi, tol mempercepat perjalanan tetapi tidak kebal terhadap kemacetan.
segments.tr: For private vehicle users, toll roads speed up travel but are not immune to congestion.

segments.src: Hal yang perlu diperhatikan:
segments.tr: Things to keep in mind:

segments.src: - **Tarif tol** pada dasarnya mengikuti ketetapan masing-masing ruas. Pada masa libur, operator kadang memberi diskon atau kebijakan khusus, tetapi ini perlu dicek pada pengumuman resmi.
segments.tr: - **Toll fares** generally follow the rates set for each road segment. During holidays, operators sometimes offer discounts or special policies, but these should be checked in official announcements.

segments.src: - **Rekayasa lalu lintas** seperti satu arah (*one way*), contraflow, atau ganjil-genap dapat diterapkan pada waktu padat oleh kepolisian. Cek informasi terkini sebelum berangkat.
segments.tr: - **Traffic management** such as one-way (*one way*), contraflow, or odd-even plate restrictions may be applied by police during busy times. Check the latest information before departing.

segments.src: - **Saldo uang elektronik** harus cukup. Isi saldo sebelum berangkat agar tidak menghambat antrean di gerbang tol.
segments.tr: - **E-money balance** must be sufficient. Top up before departing so you are not delayed in queues at toll gates.

segments.src: - **Biaya total** mencakup bahan bakar, tol, parkir, dan istirahat. Hitung semuanya sebelum membandingkannya dengan tiket kereta atau pesawat, terutama jika bepergian sendiri.
segments.tr: - **Total cost** includes fuel, tolls, parking, and rest stops. Calculate all of it before comparing with train or airfare, especially if you are traveling alone.

segments.src: ## Kesiapan Angkutan dan Layanan Pendukung
segments.tr: ## Transport Readiness and Supporting Services

segments.src: Menjelang Nataru, instansi terkait biasanya menyiapkan posko pelayanan, pemeriksaan kelaikan kendaraan, penambahan armada, serta petugas tambahan di terminal, stasiun, bandara, dan pelabuhan.
segments.tr: Ahead of Nataru, relevant agencies typically prepare service posts, vehicle roadworthiness inspections, additional fleets, and extra staff at terminals, stations, airports, and ports.

segments.src: Sebagai penumpang, Anda dapat ikut mengurangi risiko dengan:
segments.tr: As a passenger, you can help reduce risks by:

segments.src: - Memeriksa kondisi kendaraan (rem, ban, lampu, cairan) sebelum perjalanan jauh.
segments.tr: - Checking the vehicle's condition (brakes, tires, lights, fluids) before a long trip.

segments.src: - Memilih operator bus atau travel yang resmi dan memiliki izin.
segments.tr: - Choosing a bus or travel operator that is official and licensed.

segments.src: - Memantau prakiraan cuaca dari BMKG, terutama untuk perjalanan laut dan udara, karena akhir tahun identik dengan musim hujan dan gelombang tinggi di beberapa wilayah.
segments.tr: - Monitoring weather forecasts from BMKG, especially for sea and air travel, since the end of the year is associated with the rainy season and high waves in some regions.

segments.src: - Memastikan nomor kontak darurat dan lokasi posko terdekat mudah diakses.
segments.tr: - Making sure emergency contact numbers and the locations of the nearest service posts are easy to access.

segments.src: ## Langkah Merencanakan Perjalanan Lebih Awal dan Hemat
segments.tr: ## Steps to Plan Your Trip Early and Save Money

segments.src: 1. **Tentukan tanggal sejak dini.** Kepastian tanggal cuti membuat Anda bisa membeli tiket saat pilihan masih banyak.
segments.tr: 1. **Set your dates early.** Certainty about your leave dates lets you buy tickets while there are still many options.

segments.src: 2. **Fleksibel soal waktu.** Bergeser satu atau dua hari dari tanggal puncak sering kali menghemat biaya dan waktu di jalan.
segments.tr: 2. **Be flexible about timing.** Shifting by one or two days from peak dates often saves money and time on the road.

segments.src: 3. **Bandingkan moda.** Untuk jarak menengah, kereta atau bus bisa lebih ekonomis. Untuk jarak jauh, pesawat sering lebih efisien jika harganya masuk akal.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare modes of transport.** For medium distances, trains or buses can be more economical. For long distances, planes are often more efficient if the fare is reasonable.

segments.src: 4. **Susun anggaran total.** Masukkan tiket, transportasi lokal, penginapan, makan, dan dana cadangan sekitar 10–15 persen dari total.
segments.tr: 4. **Prepare a total budget.** Include tickets, local transport, accommodation, meals, and a reserve of about 10–15 percent of the total.

segments.src: 5. **Pesan penginapan lebih dahulu.** Pilih kebijakan pembatalan yang fleksibel bila memungkinkan.
segments.tr: 5. **Book accommodation first.** Choose a flexible cancellation policy if possible.

segments.src: 6. **Manfaatkan promo dengan hati-hati.** Pastikan promo berasal dari kanal resmi dan baca syarat serta ketentuannya, termasuk aturan perubahan jadwal dan pengembalian dana.
segments.tr: 6. **Use promos carefully.** Make sure promos come from official channels and read the terms and conditions, including rules on schedule changes and refunds.

segments.src: 7. **Berangkat di jam sepi.** Dini hari atau tengah malam biasanya lebih lengang untuk perjalanan darat, selama kondisi pengemudi prima.
segments.tr: 7. **Travel during quiet hours.** Early morning or midnight is usually less crowded for land travel, as long as the driver is in good condition.

segments.src: 8. **Siapkan dokumen dan kesehatan.** Bawa identitas, bukti pemesanan, dan obat pribadi. Beristirahatlah cukup sebelum berangkat.
segments.tr: 8. **Prepare documents and health.** Bring your identity document, booking proof, and personal medication. Get enough rest before departing.

segments.src: ## Waspadai Penipuan Tiket dan Penginapan
segments.tr: ## Beware of Ticket and Accommodation Scams

segments.src: Musim libur sering dimanfaatkan pihak tidak bertanggung jawab.
segments.tr: Holiday seasons are often exploited by irresponsible parties.

segments.src: Hindari menekan tautan dari pesan tidak dikenal, jangan mentransfer uang ke rekening pribadi untuk "tiket murah", dan jangan membagikan kode OTP atau data kartu kepada siapa pun.
segments.tr: Avoid clicking links in messages from unknown senders, do not transfer money to personal accounts for "cheap tickets", and do not share OTP codes or card details with anyone.

segments.src: Lakukan pembayaran hanya melalui aplikasi atau situs resmi.
segments.tr: Make payments only through official apps or websites.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Nataru 2026/2027 kemungkinan besar kembali ramai.
segments.tr: Nataru 2026/2027 will most likely be busy again.

segments.src: Kunci perjalanan yang nyaman dan hemat ada pada perencanaan awal: pilih tanggal yang fleksibel, bandingkan moda transportasi, pantau informasi resmi, dan hitung seluruh biaya perjalanan.
segments.tr: The keys to a comfortable and affordable trip lie in early planning: choose flexible dates, compare transport modes, follow official information, and calculate the total cost of the trip.

segments.src: Dengan persiapan yang matang, Anda dapat menikmati libur akhir tahun tanpa tekanan anggaran maupun kepadatan di menit-menit terakhir.
segments.tr: With thorough preparation, you can enjoy the year-end holiday without budget pressure or last-minute crowds.

id-20261022-international-logistics-tran.title: [International Logistics and Transportation #3] "City Bus" Ships vs. "Chartered Taxi" Ships: Reading the Shipping Market Structure

segments.src: > Pasar pelayaran dunia terbagi dua: kapal berjadwal tetap (liner) yang mengangkut kontainer dan kapal sewaan (tramp) yang mengangkut muatan curah. Aliansi pelayaran dan indeks tarif angkut membantu kita membaca arah pasarnya.
segments.tr: > The global shipping market is divided into two: liner shipping, which transports containers on fixed schedules, and tramp shipping, which transports bulk cargo. Shipping alliances and freight rate indices help us read the direction of the market.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Sekitar 80% volume perdagangan barang dunia diangkut lewat laut.
segments.tr: About 80% of the world's trade volume is transported by sea.

segments.src: Namun "angkutan laut" bukan satu pasar yang seragam.
segments.tr: However, "sea freight" is not a single, uniform market.

segments.src: Cara kapal beroperasi, cara tarif ditentukan, dan siapa pemainnya sangat bergantung pada jenis muatan.
segments.tr: How ships operate, how rates are determined, and who the players are depend heavily on the type of cargo.

segments.src: Memahami strukturnya membantu Anda menebak mengapa ongkos kirim bisa naik berlipat dalam beberapa bulan, atau mengapa jadwal kapal tiba-tiba berubah.
segments.tr: Understanding the structure helps you guess why shipping costs can multiply in a few months, or why ship schedules suddenly change.

segments.src: Pelayaran liner (kapal berjadwal tetap)**
segments.tr: Liner shipping (fixed-schedule ships)**

segments.src: Bayangkan bus kota.
segments.tr: Imagine a city bus.

segments.src: Ia lewat rute yang sama, berhenti di halte (pelabuhan) yang sama, dengan jadwal yang diumumkan sebelumnya, tidak peduli penuh atau tidak.
segments.tr: It follows the same route, stops at the same stops (ports), with a pre-announced schedule, regardless of whether it is full or not.

segments.src: Penumpangnya banyak dan kecil-kecil.
segments.tr: It has many small passengers.

segments.src: Di laut, "penumpang" itu adalah ribuan pengirim yang barangnya dimasukkan ke dalam kontainer.
segments.tr: At sea, those "passengers" are thousands of shippers whose goods are packed into containers.

segments.src: Tarif biasanya mengacu pada daftar tarif atau kontrak berkala per kontainer (misalnya per TEU, satuan kontainer 20 kaki).
segments.tr: Rates usually refer to a tariff list or periodic contracts per container (e.g., per TEU, a 20-foot container unit).

segments.src: Barang jadi seperti pakaian, elektronik, dan furnitur umumnya dikirim dengan cara ini.
segments.tr: Finished goods like clothing, electronics, and furniture are generally shipped this way.

segments.src: Pelayaran tramp (kapal tidak berjadwal)**
segments.tr: Tramp shipping (unscheduled ships)**

segments.src: Ini seperti taksi atau mobil carteran.
segments.tr: This is like a taxi or a chartered car.

segments.src: Kapal disewa oleh satu pengguna untuk mengangkut muatan dalam jumlah besar, misalnya batu bara, bijih nikel, gandum, atau minyak, ke tujuan mana pun yang disepakati.
segments.tr: The ship is chartered by a single user to transport large quantities of cargo, such as coal, nickel ore, grain, or oil, to any agreed-upon destination.

segments.src: Tidak ada jadwal tetap.
segments.tr: There is no fixed schedule.

segments.src: Tarif ditentukan lewat negosiasi dan sangat dipengaruhi penawaran dan permintaan saat itu.
segments.tr: Rates are determined through negotiation and are heavily influenced by supply and demand at that time.

segments.src: Bentuk sewanya antara lain *voyage charter* (sewa per pelayaran) dan *time charter* (sewa untuk jangka waktu tertentu).
segments.tr: Forms of charter include *voyage charter* (charter per voyage) and *time charter* (charter for a specific period).

segments.src: Aliansi pelayaran**
segments.tr: Shipping alliances**

segments.src: Mengoperasikan layanan liner butuh banyak kapal raksasa agar jadwal mingguan bisa terjaga.
segments.tr: Operating a liner service requires many giant ships to maintain weekly schedules.

segments.src: Karena itu, perusahaan pelayaran kontainer membentuk aliansi: mereka saling berbagi ruang di kapal dan menyusun jaringan rute bersama.
segments.tr: Therefore, container shipping companies form alliances: they share space on ships and organize joint route networks.

segments.src: Penting dicatat, aliansi adalah kerja sama **operasional**, bukan kesepakatan harga.
segments.tr: It is important to note that alliances are **operational** collaborations, not price agreements.

segments.src: Di banyak yurisdiksi, penetapan tarif bersama antarpesaing dibatasi oleh hukum persaingan usaha; Uni Eropa, misalnya, menghapus pengecualian untuk "konferensi" pelayaran (kartel tarif) pada 2008.
segments.tr: In many jurisdictions, joint rate-setting among competitors is restricted by competition law; the European Union, for example, removed the exemption for shipping "conferences" (rate cartels) in 2008.

segments.src: Sejak 2025, contoh aliansi besar adalah Gemini Cooperation (Maersk dan Hapag-Lloyd), Premier Alliance (ONE, HMM, Yang Ming), dan Ocean Alliance (CMA CGM, COSCO, OOCL, Evergreen).
segments.tr: As of 2025, examples of major alliances are the Gemini Cooperation (Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd), the Premier Alliance (ONE, HMM, Yang Ming), and the Ocean Alliance (CMA CGM, COSCO, OOCL, Evergreen).

segments.src: MSC, perusahaan terbesar menurut kapasitas, kini beroperasi sendiri setelah kerja sama 2M berakhir.
segments.tr: MSC, the largest company by capacity, now operates independently after the 2M cooperation ended.

segments.src: Susunan aliansi bisa berubah, jadi selalu periksa data terbaru.
segments.tr: Alliance structures can change, so always check the latest data.

segments.src: Indeks tarif angkut**
segments.tr: Freight rate indices**

segments.src: Karena tarif berfluktuasi, pasar memakai indeks sebagai "termometer":
segments.tr: Because rates fluctuate, the market uses indices as a "thermometer":

segments.src: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: diterbitkan Baltic Exchange di London, mencerminkan tarif sewa kapal curah kering (pasar tramp).
segments.tr: - **Baltic Dry Index (BDI)**: published by the Baltic Exchange in London, reflects charter rates for dry bulk ships (tramp market).

segments.src: - **SCFI (Shanghai Containerized Freight Index)**: tarif spot kontainer dari Shanghai ke berbagai tujuan (pasar liner).
segments.tr: - **SCFI (Shanghai Containerized Freight Index)**: spot rates for containers from Shanghai to various destinations (liner market).

segments.src: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)**: tarif spot kontainer 40 kaki di rute-rute utama.
segments.tr: - **Drewry World Container Index (WCI)**: spot rates for 40-foot containers on major routes.

segments.src: Indeks naik berarti ruang kapal makin "rebutan"; indeks turun berarti kapasitas berlebih.
segments.tr: If the index rises, it means ship space is becoming a "scramble"; if the index falls, it means there is excess capacity.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan dua pengusaha di Jawa Tengah dan Kalimantan.
segments.tr: Imagine two business owners in Central Java and Kalimantan.

segments.src: **Bu Rina**, eksportir mebel di Jepara, mengirim satu kontainer 40 kaki berisi kursi jati ke Rotterdam.
segments.tr: **Mrs. Rina**, a furniture exporter in Jepara, is shipping one 40-foot container of teak chairs to Rotterdam.

segments.src: Ia tidak menyewa kapal; ia memesan ruang lewat *freight forwarder*.
segments.tr: She does not charter a ship; she books space through a *freight forwarder*.

segments.src: Kontainernya dibawa truk ke Pelabuhan Tanjung Emas, Semarang, diangkut kapal pengumpan ke pelabuhan transit seperti Singapura, lalu dipindah ke kapal induk milik salah satu anggota aliansi menuju Eropa.
segments.tr: Her container is trucked to Tanjung Emas Port, Semarang, transported by a feeder ship to a transit port like Singapore, and then transferred to a mother vessel owned by an alliance member heading to Europe.

segments.src: Ini pelayaran **liner**.
segments.tr: This is **liner** shipping.

segments.src: Saat ia melihat SCFI melonjak, ia tahu ongkos kirim per kontainer (yang ia hitung ke rupiah) kemungkinan ikut naik dan harga jual mebelnya perlu ditinjau ulang.
segments.tr: When she sees the SCFI spike, she knows the shipping cost per container (which she calculates into rupiah) is likely to rise, and the selling price of her furniture may need to be reviewed.

segments.src: **Pak Hendra**, pedagang batu bara di Kalimantan Timur, harus mengirim puluhan ribu ton ke India.
segments.tr: **Mr. Hendra**, a coal trader in East Kalimantan, needs to ship tens of thousands of tons to India.

segments.src: Ia menyewa satu kapal curah utuh lewat *shipbroker* dengan *voyage charter*.
segments.tr: He charters an entire bulk carrier through a *shipbroker* with a *voyage charter*.

segments.src: Ini pelayaran **tramp**.
segments.tr: This is **tramp** shipping.

segments.src: Tarif yang ia bayar lebih dipengaruhi kondisi pasar kapal curah, dan BDI menjadi salah satu acuan saat ia bernegosiasi.
segments.tr: The rate he pays is more influenced by bulk carrier market conditions, and the BDI becomes one of the references when he negotiates.

segments.src: Laut yang sama, tetapi pasar, cara pemesanan, dan indeks acuannya berbeda.
segments.tr: The same ocean, but the market, booking method, and reference indices are different.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Pelayaran liner = jadwal dan rute tetap, banyak pengirim kecil, umumnya kontainer; pelayaran tramp = kapal disewa sesuai kebutuhan, muatan curah dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: 1. Liner shipping = fixed schedules and routes, many small shippers, generally containers; tramp shipping = ships chartered according to need, large quantities of bulk cargo.

segments.src: 2. Aliansi pelayaran adalah kerja sama operasional berbagi kapal dan rute antarperusahaan kontainer, bukan kesepakatan harga.
segments.tr: 2. Shipping alliances are operational collaborations to share ships and routes between container companies, not price agreements.

segments.src: 3. Indeks seperti BDI (curah) serta SCFI dan WCI (kontainer) dipakai untuk memantau naik-turunnya tarif angkut.
segments.tr: 3. Indices like the BDI (bulk) and the SCFI and WCI (container) are used to monitor the rise and fall of freight rates.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Eksportir kopi dari Lampung mengirim 2 kontainer ke Jepang dengan memesan ruang pada kapal berjadwal mingguan.
segments.tr: **1.** A coffee exporter from Lampung is shipping 2 containers to Japan by booking space on a weekly scheduled ship.

segments.src: Jenis pelayaran ini adalah…
segments.tr: This type of shipping is…

segments.src: a) Tramp  b) Liner  c) Time charter
segments.tr: a) Tramp  b) Liner  c) Time charter

segments.src: **2.** (B/S) Aliansi pelayaran pada dasarnya adalah kesepakatan para anggotanya untuk menetapkan tarif angkut yang sama.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Shipping alliances are essentially agreements among members to set the same freight rates.

segments.src: **3.** Indeks yang paling tepat untuk memantau tarif sewa kapal pengangkut batu bara adalah…
segments.tr: **3.** The most appropriate index for monitoring charter rates for coal-carrying ships is…

segments.src: a) Baltic Dry Index  b) SCFI  c) Drewry WCI
segments.tr: a) Baltic Dry Index  b) SCFI  c) Drewry WCI

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terms of the Day

segments.src: - **Pelayaran liner**: layanan angkutan laut dengan rute, jadwal, dan pelabuhan singgah tetap yang diumumkan kepada publik.
segments.tr: - **Liner shipping**: sea freight service with fixed routes, schedules, and ports of call announced to the public.

segments.src: - **Pelayaran tramp**: layanan kapal tanpa jadwal tetap yang disewa untuk muatan dan rute tertentu sesuai kesepakatan.
segments.tr: - **Tramp shipping**: unscheduled ship service chartered for specific cargo and routes according to agreement.

segments.src: - **Charter party**: kontrak sewa kapal antara pemilik kapal dan penyewa, misalnya *voyage charter* atau *time charter*.
segments.tr: - **Charter party**: a ship charter contract between the shipowner and the charterer, such as a *voyage charter* or *time charter*.

segments.src: - **Aliansi pelayaran**: kerja sama operasional antarperusahaan pelayaran kontainer untuk berbagi ruang kapal dan jaringan rute.
segments.tr: - **Shipping alliance**: operational cooperation between container shipping companies to share ship space and route networks.

segments.src: - **TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: satuan kapasitas setara satu kontainer 20 kaki.
segments.tr: - **TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit)**: a capacity unit equivalent to one 20-foot container.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) b — rute dan jadwal tetap dengan banyak pengirim kontainer adalah ciri pelayaran liner.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) b — fixed routes and schedules with many container shippers are characteristics of liner shipping.

segments.src: 2) Salah — aliansi berbagi kapal dan rute, sedangkan tarif ditetapkan masing-masing perusahaan; penetapan harga bersama dibatasi hukum persaingan usaha.
segments.tr: 2) False — alliances share ships and routes, while rates are set by each company; joint price-setting is restricted by competition law.

segments.src: 3) a — BDI mencerminkan tarif kapal curah kering seperti pengangkut batu bara, sedangkan SCFI dan WCI untuk kontainer.*
segments.tr: 3) a — the BDI reflects rates for dry bulk ships like coal carriers, while the SCFI and WCI are for containers.*
